title: Reshape the Matrix
signature: int[][] Solve(int[][] mat, int r, int c)
statement: Refill the values of mat, read row by row, into a new matrix with r rows and c columns. If the new shape cannot hold exactly the same number of values, return the original matrix unchanged.
constraints: return mat itself when rows*cols != r*c
hints: Check feasibility first: the reshape is possible exactly when rows*cols == r*c. Everything else is index arithmetic.
Give every cell a running position k from 0 upward. In the source that position is row k/cols, column k%cols; in the destination it is row k/c, column k%c.
That one identity replaces any attempt to track two pairs of counters by hand, and it is the same trick behind Convert 1D Array Into 2D Array.

cases.name: same shape is a no-op reshape
